name: NVIDIA Corp
day_summary: NVDA is recovering in early FOMC Decision Day trading to ~$210, bouncing off Tuesday's $207.41 close after a -2.37% session that saw the market reposition ahead of Warsh's first press conference. The critical complication is the VIX: it has risen to 18.28 this morning — breaching the <17 conditional-add gate from the June 10 framework for the first time since the rally began. The add at $210–$220 is technically SUSPENDED. Simultaneously, rate hike odds for 2026 have surged to 50–68% on prediction markets, and BofA is flagging at least three FOMC members expected to project 2026 rate hikes on the dot plot. The entire session hinges on one moment: Warsh's 2:30 PM ET press conference. A neutral-to-dovish dot compresses VIX back below 17 and reactivates the add at HIGH conviction; a hawkish dot (zero 2026 cuts + any hike markers) extends the consolidation and tests $200–$205.

short_pnl: no material edge — bears have VIX above 17 and hike-odds rhetoric as structural fuel, but the 2:30 PM ET presser is the only trigger that matters

decision.rationale: HOLD at medium conviction — conditional add is SUSPENDED. The June 10 three-gate framework is partially voided: VIX at 18.28 breaks the <17 gate. The other two criteria remain intact (Iran deal complete, 30Y est. ~4.93% — below 5.00%). The add at $210–$220 cannot be activated with VIX at 18.28; doing so pays for FOMC event risk without regime confirmation. Two scenarios resolve the uncertainty today: (1) Warsh delivers neutral language, dot plot keeps at least one 2026 cut in the median → VIX compresses below 17, add reactivates at HIGH conviction, path $220–$235; (2) Hawkish dot (zero 2026 cuts, any hike markers) → VIX extends above 20, NVDA tests $200–$205, full reassessment. Existing longs: maintain stop at $195 daily close. New money: no adds pre-2:30 PM ET.

what_traders_are_doing: FOMC straddle mode. The dominant posture entering the 2:30 PM ET Warsh presser: long existing NVDA with the $195 stop in place, long FOMC straddle for event convexity, and no new directional adds pre-presser. The VIX at 18.28 — above the add gate — is the market's way of pricing the hawkish tail. Desks who added at $210–$220 on June 15 are sitting with a 1–2% paper loss but well above the stop; no professional seller is pressing here ahead of a Juneteenth-thinned Friday. The disciplined view: wait for Warsh to speak at 2:30, then act on the dot plot.

analysis:
## FOMC Decision Day: the add is suspended, the thesis is intact

NVIDIA enters FOMC Decision Day at **$210** (+1.25% from Tuesday's $207.41 close), recovering in early trading but confronting a complication that wasn't present Monday or Tuesday: **VIX at 18.28**, above the <17 conditional-add gate from the June 10 framework. That gate is now suspended. Not invalidated — suspended. The three-gate framework was designed precisely for this scenario: the Iranian deal and 30Y gates are cleared, but the VIX gate is not, because FOMC-day vol is a different animal than structural macro vol.

## Why the VIX spike is about the dot plot, not the rate decision

The [CME FedWatch probability of a hold](https://intellectia.ai/blog/fed-interest-rate-decision-june-2026) is 99.6%. Nobody is pricing a June 17 rate hike — the vol premium is entirely about the dot plot that drops at 2:00 PM ET. [BofA is flagging at least three FOMC members](https://www.techtimes.com/articles/318527/20260616/federal-reserve-june-2026-meeting-warsh-set-drop-dot-hike-risk-climbs.htm) expected to project 2026 rate hikes; [prediction markets have pushed the probability of at least one 2026 hike to 50–68%](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/crypto/articles/fed-rate-hike-odds-just-065000322.html). If those three dots appear on the published chart, it is the most hawkish dot plot since 2022 and the ~31x NVDA forward multiple faces immediate re-rating pressure. That risk — a small but non-trivial probability of a historically hawkish outcome — is what VIX at 18.28 is pricing.

## The scenario map

Scenario A (neutral dot: ≥1 cut in 2026 median, zero hike markers): VIX compresses to 15–16, the <17 add gate reopens immediately, and NVDA targets $220–$235 before the June 20 monthly expiry. This is the base case given recent disinflation signals (Iran deal → oil lower → PCE relief in July data).

Scenario B (hawkish dot: zero 2026 cuts, ≥1 hike marker): VIX extends above 20, the add is off indefinitely, NVDA tests the $200–$205 zone before June 20 expiry. This is the tail. [REX Shares notes](https://www.rexshares.com/fomc-june-2026-preview-the-decision-is-settled-the-dot-plot-isnt/) that even one hike dot is a market-moving event that would represent a 180-degree pivot from the March projections.

## What to do right now

Nothing — until 2:30 PM ET. Hold existing longs with stop $195. Do not add pre-presser with VIX at 18.28. The asymmetry is favorable IF Warsh delivers a neutral dot: a same-session move from $210 to $220+ is the bull path. The August 26 Q2 FY27 earnings print at ~$91B consensus revenue is the next major anchor regardless of today's FOMC outcome.
